manifest.author: RAPP
manifest.description: Bundles a single-file agent (and optional service) into a publish-ready rapplication directory with manifest.json and a catalog index entry.
manifest.name: @rapp/rapplication_agent

action.description: What to do with the source file.

agent_path.description: Path to the *_agent.py source file. Required for all actions.

publisher.description: Publisher handle for the manifest (e.g. 'acme-team'). Defaults to 'team'.

rapp_id.description: Override the rapplication id (defaults to the agent filename minus '_agent.py').

raw_url_base.description: Optional. Base raw-URL for the catalog index entry, e.g. 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acme/rapp_store/main'. The bundler appends '/<id>/<file>' to build singleton_url and service_url.

service_path.description: Optional path to a paired *_service.py. Bundled alongside the agent.
